text:
Type: small square side table on casters
Use: holding a lamp, drinks or books beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: white laminated board, chrome-look casters
Colors: white, silver
Shape: cube-like silhouette, square top with rounded edges, open lower shelf, four block legs on small round wheels, compact and mobile
Feel: clean, bright, practical, tidy
Goes with: white or light grey furniture, light wood floors, simple accents; Scandinavian or modern living rooms and small apartments

product.name: TINGBY
product.description: Separate shelf for magazines, etc. helps you keep your things organised and the table top clear.
